data.body:
CI STATE (not waiting on Verified — the blocker is owned by [rebar:e47e-a33d-b9cf-4421]).

Gerrit 1231 (diagnosis pin, tests only) and 1232 (the fix), stacked. BOTH have LLM-Review +1.
Verified is -1 on both, from ONE job: `pip-audit (dependency vulnerabilities)`, on
`click 8.2.1` / PYSEC-2026-2132 — the pre-existing `main` failure, confirmed from the job log,
not this change. EVERY OTHER JOB IS GREEN on both runs (15 jobs each, 14 green):

  pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.11 / py3.12 / py3.13), pytest (macos-latest, py3.13),
  lint + type-check, golden-path (clean install), verify-identity (whole-store authorship gate),
  require resolvable rebar ticket, artifact-probe (wheel/sdist provenance),
  optionality (optional extras + clean core wheel), eval-discipline (offline eval gate),
  clear Verified, cast Verified.

I posted `recheck` on both BEFORE learning the failure is not recheckable (the workflow only
retries advisory-DB-UNREACHABLE failures, and this audit reaches the DB and finds a real
finding). Harmless — the re-runs will land the same -1. `uv.lock` and
`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` were NOT touched, per the ownership constraint.

Local evidence for the same suites CI runs: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler + tests/integration =
2000 passed. The two 5200 modules = 11 passed.
